feed.title: AwesomeCUA: newly reviewed resources
feed.subtitle: Computer-use agent papers, models, datasets, benchmarks and tools as they pass source review, newest review first. Metadata-only bibliography records and unreviewed candidates are not included.
feed.rights: Catalog annotations: MIT. Linked resources keep their own terms.

entry.title: Frigate
entry.summary: A Swift ML package that includes a macOS screen-perception module. It detects regions, recognizes text, classifies interface roles, and produces a page map.

entry.title: agentd
entry.summary: AgentD exposes a desktop session through an HTTP API for screenshots, mouse and keyboard actions, browser opening, and session recording.

entry.title: Blender AI Plugin
entry.summary: Blender AI Plugin equips an agent to inspect and edit an open Blender scene through MCP, using an orchestrator, skills, and scripts for asset workflows.

entry.title: Caster User Directory
entry.summary: Caster User Directory combines Windows voice automation with window switching and accessibility-based tracking of focused desktop context.

entry.title: CloakBrowser
entry.summary: CloakBrowser provides a modified Chromium build with Playwright and Puppeteer compatible APIs for scripted browser interaction.

entry.title: easyGooglePlay
entry.summary: easyGooglePlay is an agent skill for building Android releases and completing Google Play Console publishing steps through a signed-in browser bridge.

entry.title: OpenHuman
entry.summary: OpenHuman is an agent harness offered as a desktop app and Rust library, with browser and desktop controls that select actions from visible buttons.

entry.title: Patchright
entry.summary: Patchright is a modified Playwright driver for Chromium automation, with browser interaction through Playwright-style APIs and separate client packages.

entry.title: WebVIA
entry.summary: WebVIA links an agent that explores web pages and records actions to modules that generate HTML and verify the resulting interface.

entry.title: WildAWM
entry.summary: WildAWM supplies a pipeline for generating computer environments and cross-interface tasks, with execution checks and tools for evaluating agents.

entry.title: bb-sites
entry.summary: A collection of JavaScript adapters that turn site searches, data retrieval and selected account actions into commands run through a logged-in browser.

entry.title: cmux
entry.summary: A macOS terminal and workspace app with a scriptable browser that lets agents inspect page accessibility data, click elements, fill forms and run JavaScript.

entry.title: DeskMind Hands
entry.summary: A desktop agent harness that runs planner decisions through macOS input and accessibility controls, with a mock desktop, task verification and oracle-labelled training workflows.

entry.title: Solari Research Suite: ARC & ColdStart
entry.summary: A research suite combining an accessibility-based browser-agent harness with an evaluation harness that changes a web task app and verifies completed actions against database state.

entry.title: @sparticuz/chromium
entry.summary: @sparticuz/chromium supplies a headless Linux Chromium build and launch settings for serverless browser automation with Puppeteer or Playwright.

entry.title: Agenta
entry.summary: Agenta is a team workspace for building and running agents. Its agents can use a browser and files to work on websites, alongside connected apps and scheduled automations.

entry.title: arc-cua
entry.summary: arc-cua is a macOS computer-use package with an app-window driver and a decision-model loop for executing bounded desktop subtasks handed off by an agent.

entry.title: ChromiumFish
entry.summary: ChromiumFish packages a modified Chromium browser for Playwright and external agents. It also includes an agent that reads pages and performs clicks, typing, and navigation.

entry.title: PeekabooX
entry.summary: PeekabooX is a Linux desktop automation toolkit with screen capture, semantic UI inspection, input actions, and workflows exposed through CLI, Python, and MCP interfaces.

entry.title: Qontinui Runner
entry.summary: Qontinui Runner is a desktop application that executes configured GUI automation projects and monitors their progress. It supports mouse, keyboard, and screen actions.

entry.title: Mechanize
entry.summary: Mechanize is a Ruby library that automates website interactions, including navigation, cookie handling, and form submission.

entry.title: Mind2Web-cleaned-lite-value-model-w-cot-test
entry.summary: A Mind2Web dataset of 6125 web-action records with element candidates, accessibility trees, prior actions, rationales, and value scores.

entry.title: InternVL3-78B
entry.summary: InternVL3-78B is a released multimodal checkpoint whose model-family card describes GUI-operation training data and a GUI-grounding evaluation alongside broader vision-language tasks.

entry.title: jev-browser
entry.summary: jev-browser is an MCP server that lets an agent navigate Chromium pages through Jev-selected actions. It checks page changes and returns uncertain steps to the driving agent.

entry.title: KC Browser
entry.summary: KC Browser is a Chromium-based browser binary for automated web sessions. It generates seeded browser identities and can be launched through Playwright or Puppeteer.

entry.title: Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni-30B-A3B-Reasoning-BF16
entry.summary: Nemotron 3 Nano Omni is a released multimodal model for image, video, audio and text understanding. Its card identifies GUI capability and automation for browser agents among its uses.

entry.title: PlayCoder
entry.summary: PlayCoder generates and refines GUI application code using interactive tests. Its PlayTester observes application screenshots, performs interface actions and feeds results into repair.

entry.title: Scrapeless Python SDK
entry.summary: The Scrapeless Python SDK creates managed browser sessions for Playwright and Pyppeteer, supports persistent profiles, and exposes web interaction and extraction services.

entry.title: TagUI
entry.summary: TagUI runs scripted flows across websites and desktop applications using web, image, text or coordinate targets. Its MCP server exposes flow creation and execution to AI clients.

entry.title: Contrastive Language Models
entry.summary: CLM-8B ranks candidate actions against a state with separate embeddings and a serving API. Its authors report evaluations that include computer-use tasks.

entry.title: CUA Skill
entry.summary: CUA Skill runs Windows desktop tasks by retrieving and executing reusable action sequences. Its agent modes use screenshots, accessibility trees, and visual grounding.

entry.title: FlaUI
entry.summary: FlaUI is a .NET library for locating and operating Windows application controls through Microsoft UI Automation. It supports automated interface tests and interactions.

entry.title: Lightpanda Skill for LLM Agents
entry.summary: Lightpanda Skill for LLM Agents gives agents instructions for using Lightpanda's browser interfaces for interactive browsing and for creating reusable PandaScript tasks.

entry.title: Predicate Python SDK
entry.summary: The Predicate Python SDK gives browser agents semantic page snapshots, UI assertions, and run traces so they can verify actions and inspect failures.

entry.title: predicate-secure
entry.summary: predicate-secure is a security wrapper for browser agents that checks actions against policy, verifies outcomes, and records audit evidence.

entry.title: Blade Code
entry.summary: Blade Code is a coding agent with native Chromium automation, ARIA page snapshots, and browser actions available through its agent workflow.

entry.title: CodexQA Jev Browser
entry.summary: CodexQA Jev Browser operates Playwright pages through indexed controls and model-selected actions, with case replay and reports based on visible page evidence.

entry.title: cube-harness
entry.summary: cube-harness runs agent evaluations across compatible benchmarks, including MiniWob, and provides trajectories, screenshots, and an experiment viewer.

entry.title: DesignRepair
entry.summary: DesignRepair analyzes frontend code and rendered pages, then uses Material Design guidance and an LLM to identify and repair interface design issues.

entry.title: dsh-plugin-browser
entry.summary: dsh-plugin-browser adds model-callable Playwright tools to DeepSeek Harness for reading rendered pages, navigating, clicking, typing, and taking screenshots.

entry.title: GA-Technical-Report
entry.summary: Evaluation materials for GenericAgent cover web browsing and other agent tasks, with benchmark folders documenting setup, protocols, and reproduction.

entry.title: Pydoll
entry.summary: Pydoll is a Python browser automation library that controls Chrome or Edge through the DevTools Protocol and supports navigation, element interaction, and extraction.

entry.title: TeleGen
entry.summary: TeleGen runs browser tasks against instrumented web apps, condenses interaction telemetry, and gives the resulting evidence to a code repair agent.

entry.title: Ferrum
entry.summary: Ferrum is a Ruby API for controlling Chrome or Chromium through the DevTools Protocol. It supports browser navigation, page interaction and screenshots.

entry.title: fingerprint-suite
entry.summary: Fingerprint Suite generates browser fingerprints and injects them into Playwright or Puppeteer browser sessions. Its packages also generate configurable HTTP headers.

entry.title: NotebookLM Claude Code Skill
entry.summary: A Claude Code skill automates browser-based questions to NotebookLM and returns answers from uploaded documents. It includes scripts for authentication and notebook management.

entry.title: PhoneHarness
entry.summary: PhoneHarness evaluates Android phone agents that combine GUI actions with device commands and host tools. It provides a runtime, a benchmark runner subset and trace-based checks of task outcomes.

entry.title: SnapDOM
entry.summary: SnapDOM captures rendered browser elements and exports images or structured page context. Its plugins can provide agents with text, JSON and images paired with element maps.

entry.title: SoftwareGym
entry.summary: SoftwareGym synthesizes runnable GUI applications as environments for computer-use agents. It tests generated apps through screenshot-based actions in Ubuntu virtual machines and uses feedback to repair them.

entry.title: aworld-mcp-servers
entry.summary: A collection of service endpoints that includes a Browser Use API for natural-language web tasks. Its browser endpoint can return an execution trace.

entry.title: Bodhi
entry.summary: Bodhi is a desktop agent workbench built around a Rust runtime. Its optional Nova tools let the agent operate native applications and browsers.

entry.title: InternVL3_5-4B-HF
entry.summary: An HF-format checkpoint in the InternVL3.5 multimodal model family, whose card names GUI interaction among its capabilities. The release includes model weights.

entry.title: KWWKComputerUseCore
entry.summary: A Swift computer-use runtime that captures macOS app state and screenshots and sends mouse and keyboard actions. It offers structured and agent-facing outputs.

entry.title: Adapt ERP
entry.summary: Adapt ERP is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that explores signed-in ERP pages, keeps a local index of observed menus and fields, and requests approval before writes.

entry.title: AutoWebNav
entry.summary: AutoWebNav is a .NET library for WebView2 browser automation, combining page actions and element resolution with interaction recording and live observation.

entry.title: Co-Design Bench
entry.summary: Co-Design Bench evaluates application revisions from multimodal requests using 96 editing tasks with annotated screenshots and 521 criteria checked against source and browser evidence.

entry.title: Council Bridge
entry.summary: Council Bridge is a browser extension that routes human messages between assigned ChatGPT and Gemini tabs and captures their replies in a side panel.

entry.title: LCU
entry.summary: LCU connects an installed desktop computer-use runtime to agent harnesses for window observation and input actions, with optional control of approved Chrome tabs.

entry.title: pyppeteer
entry.summary: Pyppeteer is a Python library for automating Chrome and Chromium pages, with APIs for navigation, screenshots, element queries, and page JavaScript.

entry.title: appium-android
entry.summary: A monorepo of Appium packages for Android device and UI automation, including an Android driver, an ADB wrapper, and a device server for UiAutomator2 commands.

entry.title: AutoDesign
entry.summary: An agentic design system that turns a paper into editable posters, slides, webpages, and videos. Its workflow uses a browser audit to check rendered screen and print output.

entry.title: BlenderWorld
entry.summary: A benchmark of 223 Blender creation tasks with text, image, and video inputs. Agents submit editable projects for rendering and rubric-based evaluation.

entry.title: Scenario for Blender
entry.summary: A Blender extension for generating media and scene assets. Its local MCP server lets agents inspect an open scene and request generation work.

entry.title: Scrapeless Node SDK
entry.summary: A Node.js SDK for creating browser sessions controlled through Playwright or Puppeteer. It also exposes browser profiles, crawling, scraping, and proxy services.

entry.title: UI2Code^N
entry.summary: A UI-to-code system that drafts interface code from screenshots and refines it through repeated rendering and visual feedback. The repository provides demos and evaluation scripts.

entry.title: Appium Mac2 Driver
entry.summary: Appium Mac2 Driver uses Apple's XCTest framework to automate macOS applications through Appium.

entry.title: Korgo Bot
entry.summary: Korgo Bot is a macOS app for persistent bots that share a cloud desktop. Bots can use screen and file tools or send GUI and browser tasks to a hosted agent.

entry.title: Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct-AWQ
entry.summary: This instruction-tuned Qwen2.5-VL checkpoint supports visual localization and tool-directed computer and phone use. The repository provides weights and inference examples.

entry.title: WebRetriever
entry.summary: WebRetriever supplies a web-agent evaluation runner and a judge that assesses task completion from captured requests, actions and page URLs.

entry.title: Blender Agent Studio
entry.summary: Blender Agent Studio connects coding agents to local Blender to create editable scenes, render previews and inspect visual results.

entry.title: BrowserMCP
entry.summary: BrowserMCP connects AI clients to a Chrome extension through a Node.js MCP server and WebSocket bridge for browser navigation and interaction.

entry.title: Codex Minecraft Gameplay
entry.summary: Codex Minecraft Gameplay supplies Windows input controls and screenshots so computer-use agents can act through Minecraft's visible interface.

entry.title: cookie-use
entry.summary: cookie-use stores website sessions in an encrypted vault and lets agents select accounts and apply their sessions to browser contexts.

entry.title: Eko
entry.summary: Eko is a JavaScript framework for building multi-step agents that operate in computer and browser environments, with workflow and tool controls.

entry.title: GameWorld Games
entry.summary: GameWorld Games supplies browser-game snapshots for agent evaluation, each with an API for initialization, reset and game-state inspection.

entry.title: Halluminate Westworld
entry.summary: Halluminate Westworld evaluates web agents on tasks set in realistic websites and provides task loading, a manual demo and evaluator interfaces.

entry.title: KV-Ground
entry.summary: KV-Ground releases compact models for locating targets in high-resolution GUI images, alongside training and evaluation code.

entry.title: lumos_unified_plan_iterative-13B
entry.summary: A Lumos planning checkpoint fine-tuned on web-agent, question-answering, multimodal and math tasks within a modular agent system.

entry.title: Magnitude WebVoyager Benchmark Results
entry.summary: A WebVoyager evaluation release for the Magnitude browser agent, including reported task results, task patches and reproduction instructions.

entry.title: Mobile Agent
entry.summary: Mobile Agent is an Android assistant that can use local tools and optional accessibility-based device control, with approval for sensitive actions.

entry.title: MWMBench
entry.summary: MWMBench evaluates mobile GUI world models by asking them to predict the next screen from a screenshot and coordinate action.

entry.title: profile-use
entry.summary: profile-use supplies local profile data for agent-driven web forms and applies confirmation and domain checks before sensitive entries or submission.

entry.title: Q-Verifier / Q-Reflector
entry.summary: Q-Reflector checks a GUI agent's action against before-and-after screenshots and task context, with training and online evaluation code.

entry.title: Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct
entry.summary: A Qwen3-VL vision-language checkpoint whose card describes visual-agent operation of PC and mobile GUIs, including element recognition and tool use.

entry.title: Snapgrab
entry.summary: Snapgrab captures website screenshots and page metadata through a Python API and MCP tools, with viewport and image-format options.

entry.title: Thursday
entry.summary: Thursday is a local voice assistant that delegates longer tasks to bots able to use a browser, shell and files while the conversation continues.

entry.title: Aico Link Firmware
entry.summary: Aico Link firmware runs an agent that views a phone or computer through HDMI capture and sends input through USB HID. The repository includes hardware services, agent runtime, and update tooling.

entry.title: Interlock Relay
entry.summary: Interlock Relay is an Android library that connects sandboxed agents to host-app capabilities through an approval gate. It provides execution backends, quotas, artifacts, and audit logs.

entry.title: open-compute-mcp
entry.summary: open-compute-mcp launches a Python computer-use MCP server and relays requests over local standard I/O. The backend exposes Windows desktop capture, interface inspection, and input tools.

entry.title: Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct
entry.summary: Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct is a released vision-language checkpoint. Its card describes visual-agent computer and phone use, visual localization, and interface benchmark results.

entry.title: Solari Cookbook
entry.summary: Solari Cookbook collects runnable examples for cloud browsers, sandboxes, and desktops, including browser session recording and screenshot, click, and typing operations on a Linux GUI.

entry.title: aevra-desktop
entry.summary: A desktop-control MCP server that lets agents inspect and operate application controls through accessibility APIs, with screenshots and an application allowlist.

entry.title: awb-recipes
entry.summary: A collection of dated recipes for browser agents to complete tasks on logged-in sites, recording action steps, selectors, caveats and verification status.

entry.title: BrowserGym-Knows
entry.summary: A BrowserGym fork for evaluating agents on Google Workspace tasks performed in Chromium, with task results graded through Workspace APIs.

entry.title: clawtouch-hid
entry.summary: CircuitPython firmware and a Python wire protocol module that let host software send keyboard and mouse actions through a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 USB HID device.

entry.title: computer-use
entry.summary: An archived macOS broker that lets MCP clients delegate computer-use tasks to the official Codex runtime and receive the nested agent's final response.

entry.title: gohook
entry.summary: A Go library for listening to keyboard and mouse events, with callback registration and an event stream that can support capture of desktop interactions.

entry.title: handraise-telegram
entry.summary: A Telegram adapter for browser-agent handoffs that sends a page screenshot and approval buttons to a chat, then returns the person's decision.

entry.title: LangHire
entry.summary: A desktop app whose browser agents search for jobs and complete online applications, using stored knowledge of applicant tracking systems across tasks.

entry.title: mano-afk
entry.summary: An app-building agent that deploys software and tests it through browser GUI actions, with retry loops and an included benchmark for GUI automation.
